name: The Truth and the Outline of the Adventure

pages.name: The Truth and the Outline of the Adventure

text.content: Phase 2. Working document for the Storyteller. All cross-references are by ID.

Charles Halloway (@UUID[JournalEntry.uDNdrVnGBbAh18Tt]{Charles Halloway}), the Ventrue Primogen, wants the crown of Seattle. He can't bring down Prince Whitmore (@UUID[JournalEntry.sCVTjJFrnyyVnQDt]{Marcus Whitmore}) while Sheriff Montgomery (@UUID[JournalEntry.1UgmJAqeofD7SSaf]{Ethan Montgomery}) and his Hound, David Smith (@UUID[JournalEntry.3zcQLj7aEAxHT0Yr]{David Smith}), keep the city clean. His plan has three pieces:

  • The File. His ghoul Preston Gale (@UUID[JournalEntry.y8Ao3xEHH3W11EJe]{Preston Gale}), owner of a home security and camera company, locates the archive of Helen Ward (@UUID[JournalEntry.fVXK7vOoqn0ZL0uf]{Helen Ward}) through his own customers' data. A team of mortals steals it.
  • The ghost. In 1986, Halloway bought the journals of Marcus Vance (@UUID[JournalEntry.WIihWwv4LCOX68B1]{Marcus “Ironjaw” Vance}), which were never burned. With them he hires August Krell (@UUID[JournalEntry.OmK2qlPVNl758u6h]{August Krell}), a Brujah whom Vance trained and abandoned in the '70s. Krell destroys the Kindred who could expose the theft, imitating Controlled Fury. That achieves two things: David chases a dead man, and Montgomery starts to distrust him.
  • The leak. Halloway hands the Second Inquisition (FIRSTLIGHT) hand-picked fragments of the File. They point only at assets of Whitmore and Montgomery. When the raid comes, he'll convene the Primogen to demand a regent “capable of protecting the Masquerade”: himself.

Vance isn't in Seattle. Every sign of him is fake. What is real is Krell, the other son, the one who wasn't chosen.

It's a tracker from 0 to 10 that measures how much the Second Inquisition knows. It starts at 2. It rises with Masquerade breaches, public violence, contact between Helen and FIRSTLIGHT, and the fragments Halloway leaks each night the plot advances unanswered. It drops when the coterie cleans up traces, recovers copies of the File, or neutralizes the mole.

Threshold What happens in the city
3 FIRSTLIGHT puts Helen under surveillance: vans, drones, and an analyst who listens closely to her podcast.
5 Agent Dana Okafor (@UUID[JournalEntry.bJA2iRyDgbm2TcuK]{Dana Okafor}) contacts Helen and offers her protection in exchange for the archive.
7 They investigate one of David's mortal assets (Bear's contacts or the hangar's cover). Resources or Haven at risk.
9 The @UUID[JournalEntry.doItxeK8y7M1PufU.JournalEntryPage.ogKpm1VYgcVGCw1T]{A4-E02 · The Raid} raid triggers.
10 Purge. At least one Camarilla haven falls, and the city enters a Masquerade crisis for the rest of the chronicle.

Editor's Note · Thresholds

Later installments refine this table and take precedence over it. At 7, the investigation targets “a coterie asset: the hangar partnership, the medical examiner's office, Nadia's calendar” (doc 10), with Okafor's visit to the M.E. “R. A.” (doc 14). At 10, “the chronicle continues in survival mode” (doc 10). The current version is in @UUID[JournalEntry.b13NIR35K7HpthZv]{FIRSTLIGHT's Thermometer} and in the @UUID[JournalEntry.LkbsP03WDYiTwRRX]{Storyteller Screen}.

Length: 6–8 sessions. Format: a coterie of 4–5 players with the new PCs; David and Bear go along as allied NPCs (updated decision 4, @UUID[JournalEntry.xkgduTFLzE5Eik8z]{How to Use This Module}). The original outline was for a single player, David, with Bear.

Structure: Prologue and four parts. Parts 1 and 2 can be played in any order. The city moves on its own: each night without a response, Halloway leaks a fragment (Thermometer +1) and Krell takes another step.

What happens if the coterie doesn't intervene.

Night Event
1 The theft (Prologue).
2 Krell destroys the first buyer of a copy (@UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.DtetdHiBnOLQaM6Y]{A1-E02 · Ash on Pier 46}).
3 Halloway sows doubts about Montgomery in Elysium (@UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.uL8F2YNogcToiFc6]{A2-E01 · Elysium Night}).
4 Second victim, with Vance's signature (@UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.j4TnqYOwVuSCeQ0z]{A2-E02 · “Locate. Assess. Execute.”}).
5 First fragment leaked to FIRSTLIGHT. Okafor contacts Helen.
6 Krell goes after Bear or Helen (@UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.7brn5AgmWggUl420]{A3-E01 · The Other Son}).
7 Montgomery receives “evidence” against David (@UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.aGN9NHO00wmdUzVn]{A3-E04 · The Pack Wavers}).
8 FIRSTLIGHT raid and Primogen Council (A4).

Editor's Note · The Clock and the Installments

This is the outline's Clock (doc 01). The chapter 7 Clock (@UUID[JournalEntry.ll97TEj4MRjtM595]{Chapter 7 · The Ward File}, doc 10) takes precedence, with Nights 2 through 6 updated in @UUID[JournalEntry.nuyiQmnE32yq4wOG]{Revision to Part 1 · The Chain of Copies} (doc 11). Halloway doesn't leak a fragment every night: he makes two drops as ARCHER, on Nights 2 and 5 (Thermometer +1 each; docs 10 and 14). The raid and the Council land on Night 8, but the raid only happens if the Thermometer is at 9 or higher.

• @UUID[JournalEntry.w9xeQJg6psfiMjFU.JournalEntryPage.yyXMKcpDOIhGuZIB]{A0-E01 · The Call from SAFE} · The Call from SAFE. It's 3:19 a.m. Helen calls the only number in her flip phone: someone has broken into her apartment (@UUID[JournalEntry.YD0Td8Y9aJyIpGSl]{Helen Ward's Apartment}). The coterie arrives before the police, with David and Bear. Tests: tracking, cleaning the scene, and handling Helen. Exits: @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.T8gJWjZpOnL4OisP]{A1-E01 · What They Took}.

Editor's Note · The Time of the Call

The outline (doc 01) put SAFE's call at 3:12. It's corrected to 3:19, the time in chapter 7 (doc 10, @UUID[JournalEntry.w9xeQJg6psfiMjFU.JournalEntryPage.yyXMKcpDOIhGuZIB]{A0-E01 · The Call from SAFE}): the break-in is at 3:04 and the cameras are off from 2:52 to 3:03.

• @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.T8gJWjZpOnL4OisP]{A1-E01 · What They Took} · What They Took. Helen's apartment. The thieves were mortal professionals, and the building's cameras were looped (P-01). Helen makes the list of what was stolen (@UUID[JournalEntry.ifdmxLzsoLizs9uN]{Index of the Ward File}). There's a whiff of someone else's Vitae on the doorknob: it belongs to a ghoul (P-02). Exits: @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.DtetdHiBnOLQaM6Y]{A1-E02 · Ash on Pier 46}, @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.lM1EiE1FoXMkf3Uo]{A1-E04 · Everything Sells Below}, @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.wIpc0OR2nQf7WDFO]{A1-E05 · The City's Eyes}.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.DtetdHiBnOLQaM6Y]{A1-E02 · Ash on Pier 46} · Ash on Pier 46. A minor Nosferatu turns up destroyed on Harbor Island, half a mile from David's haven. The blows follow the doctrine of Controlled Fury (P-03). On the body is a USB drive with a partial copy of the File (P-04). Witness: @UUID[JournalEntry.BxMkvzNl7Yt8OyTI]{r/SeattleAfterDark: “Anyone Else See This on Harbor Island?”}. Exits: @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.xWx5IoPih8fX83b1]{A1-E03 · The Sheriff Asks}.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.xWx5IoPih8fX83b1]{A1-E03 · The Sheriff Asks} · The Sheriff Asks. At Montgomery's farm (@UUID[JournalEntry.NNzMhIvsavpG0iTQ]{The Sheriff's Farm and Boat Landing}). He recognizes the technique and asks what nobody wants to hear: “Is your sire alive?” He gives David and the coterie three nights, and assigns David to go with it. If the Thermometer is at 4 or higher, Montgomery is in a worse mood. Exits: @UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.uL8F2YNogcToiFc6]{A2-E01 · Elysium Night}, @UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.wQ2BqzruUybEIhSO]{A2-E04 · The Sheriff That Was}.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.lM1EiE1FoXMkf3Uo]{A1-E04 · Everything Sells Below} · Everything Sells Down Below. In the underground (@UUID[JournalEntry.jg1zpvYlDFMJRY8Q]{The Sealed Underground (Seattle Underground)}). Thornquist confirms that there are copies of the File on the market and that the courier is a thin-blood, Jun (P-05). Branch: rescuing Jun opens @UUID[JournalEntry.AnZpyM4onyACPwiC.JournalEntryPage.cjmyT3bfPbka0X6O]{GAN-11 · Jun's Fast}; if the coterie doesn't, Krell destroys her on Night 4. Exits: @UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.j4TnqYOwVuSCeQ0z]{A2-E02 · “Locate. Assess. Execute.”}, @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.EjJ0vfVBCjTTb0QV]{A3-E02 · The Data Center}.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.wIpc0OR2nQf7WDFO]{A1-E05 · The City's Eyes} · The City's Eyes (optional; skip it if the coterie doesn't follow the tech trail). The doorbell cameras in Helen's building are all Gale Sentinel. The company received a data request that appears in no record (P-06). Exits: @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.EjJ0vfVBCjTTb0QV]{A3-E02 · The Data Center}.

• @UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.uL8F2YNogcToiFc6]{A2-E01 · Elysium Night} · Elysium Night. At the Glass Gallery (@UUID[JournalEntry.iyojT7kJHH23BWLd]{The Glass Gallery (Elysium)}). It's a social scene: Halloway, Marchetti, Voight, and Fry. Halloway mentions Vance with a detail he shouldn't know (P-07). Fry recites @UUID[JournalEntry.FVBnf3yE87K4BOhh]{Wendell Fry: “Song for the Son of the Fist”}. Voight warns them privately that FIRSTLIGHT has opened a case file. Exits: @UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.j4TnqYOwVuSCeQ0z]{A2-E02 · “Locate. Assess. Execute.”}, @UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.wQ2BqzruUybEIhSO]{A2-E04 · The Sheriff That Was}.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.j4TnqYOwVuSCeQ0z]{A2-E02 · “Locate. Assess. Execute.”} · “Locate. Assess. Execute.” The second victim has Vance's watchword written on the wall. An Intelligence + Brawl (Difficulty 4) test reveals that the technique is wrong: Krell strikes from the inverted guard, the way Vance taught the students who never finished their training (P-08). Exits: @UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.wQ2BqzruUybEIhSO]{A2-E04 · The Sheriff That Was}, @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.7brn5AgmWggUl420]{A3-E01 · The Other Son}.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.aJxUAHXcYpRWrhmG]{A2-E03 · Salt's} · Salt's (optional). In Everett (@UUID[JournalEntry.JMwTSsJAcyYdCs3m]{Salt's Bar and the Old Shipyard}). Rosa Iturbe receives the coterie and David with hostility: Halloway spread the word that the Anarchs are behind the deaths. Rosa knew the Anarch who killed Emily. If David hears it, he breaks down or explodes: the Storyteller plays him, and the coterie has to hold him together. Branch: an alliance with Rosa (allies at the climax) or a confrontation (@UUID[JournalEntry.AnZpyM4onyACPwiC.JournalEntryPage.0e8h94hwnGDTnixI]{GAN-06 · Blood Hunt in Everett}). Exits: @UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.wQ2BqzruUybEIhSO]{A2-E04 · The Sheriff That Was}.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.wQ2BqzruUybEIhSO]{A2-E04 · The Sheriff That Was} · The Sheriff That Was. In Tacoma, where O'Connor lives in exile. He tells them that Vance's journals were never burned: in 1986 they were sold to “a Seattle Ventrue with patience” (P-09). He hands over @UUID[JournalEntry.4858IAb89fTokFfV]{Letter from Sheriff O'Connor to Prince Whitmore, 1978}. If the coterie goes near the Larchmont Building (@UUID[JournalEntry.Oiln4o98kvxKbOvS]{The Larchmont Building}), go to @UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.9fTKL8Oeq36BCfU9]{A2-E05 · The Ashes of the Larchmont}. Exits: @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.7brn5AgmWggUl420]{A3-E01 · The Other Son}, @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.EjJ0vfVBCjTTb0QV]{A3-E02 · The Data Center}.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.9fTKL8Oeq36BCfU9]{A2-E05 · The Ashes of the Larchmont} · The Ashes of the Larchmont (optional; depends on decision 5). The burned building that marked Helen's career. The File has a folder on it. What the coterie finds depends on the truth about the fire; what it tells David depends on the players.

• @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.7brn5AgmWggUl420]{A3-E01 · The Other Son} · The Other Son. Krell ambushes Bear or Helen (whoever is more exposed) wearing Vance's coat. It's a combat and chase scene. If the coterie arrives in time, Krell flees and leaves a message. If it doesn't, Bear is badly wounded or Helen is abducted. Exits: @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.hAX2tLfjRPJ2o4Tr]{A3-E03 · Face to Face with Krell}.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.EjJ0vfVBCjTTb0QV]{A3-E02 · The Data Center} · The Data Center. Infiltration of Gale Sentinel (@UUID[JournalEntry.zSkwEUUtkNGhfXun]{Gale Sentinel Campus and Data Center}). The coterie finds the master copy of the File, the log of shipments to “SEA-0411” (P-10), and the digital signature of Preston Gale, Halloway's ghoul (P-11). Options: stealth, Dominate on the guards, or an assault, which raises the Thermometer +2.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.hAX2tLfjRPJ2o4Tr]{A3-E03 · Face to Face with Krell} · Face to Face with Krell. At the port's cargo terminal or wherever Krell chooses. Krell demands David; the coterie decides whether to bring him and how. Krell doesn't want to win: he wants David to see him. He offers to trade information for recognition. What softens him are the truths the PCs tell him, with David at their side. Branch (the players choose): destroy him, hand him over to the Sheriff, or turn him into a witness against Halloway (P-12).
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.aGN9NHO00wmdUzVn]{A3-E04 · The Pack Wavers} · The Pack Wavers. Halloway gives Montgomery “evidence” that David is protecting his sire. Montgomery summons the coterie and David. Branch: convince him (the PC speaking for the coterie rolls Manipulation + Persuasion, Difficulty 4, +1 die for each clue from P-07 through P-15: Manipulation + Persuasion (Difficulty 4)), confront him, or flee. If it goes badly, the coterie reaches the climax as fugitives, and David with them.

Editor's Note · Clues for A3-E04

The outline (doc 01) gave +1 die for each clue from P-07 to P-12. Part 3 (doc 12) expands the list to P-07 through P-15 and adds other modifiers (Krell as a witness, the Sheriff's favor, the lie from A1-E03): doc 12 takes precedence. See @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.aGN9NHO00wmdUzVn]{A3-E04 · The Pack Wavers}.

• @UUID[JournalEntry.doItxeK8y7M1PufU.JournalEntryPage.snrsN5RkdAklRIDn]{A4-E01 · Primogen Council} · Primogen Council. In the penthouse of Halloway Tower (@UUID[JournalEntry.L6Fl1S0tjkWno2we]{Halloway Tower}). Halloway presents his motion against the Prince. The coterie can interrupt it with evidence, stay silent, or negotiate in private beforehand.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.doItxeK8y7M1PufU.JournalEntryPage.ogKpm1VYgcVGCw1T]{A4-E02 · The Raid} · The Raid (triggers if the Thermometer reaches 9). FIRSTLIGHT storms a target from the File: the Sheriff's farm (@UUID[JournalEntry.NNzMhIvsavpG0iTQ]{The Sheriff's Farm and Boat Landing}) or David's hangar (@UUID[JournalEntry.104UV0anmZHNCTrD]{The Harbor Island Hangar}). They have to escape, save Bear, and destroy evidence.
  • @UUID[JournalEntry.doItxeK8y7M1PufU.JournalEntryPage.tG1m5PTkmBA1pvmc]{A4-E03 · The Last Ferry} · The Last Ferry. At the terminal (@UUID[JournalEntry.IDd94316DhSx3ptV]{The Ferry Terminal and the Last Ferry}). Halloway tries to get the original copy out of the city, to hand it to the Justicar or to FIRSTLIGHT. It's the final confrontation.

ID Ending Consequences
@UUID[JournalEntry.oyw1B5aZ7G2vFDuO.JournalEntryPage.UnOqmjERvnxNb7gL]{FIN-A · The Truth Before the Throne} Truth Before the Throne. The coterie exposes Halloway with evidence. Halloway is destroyed or banished. The coterie gains Status (Camarilla) +1. Montgomery owes them one. The Thermometer drops 2.
@UUID[JournalEntry.oyw1B5aZ7G2vFDuO.JournalEntryPage.RqeQkW5KfFjPYFhg]{FIN-B · The Hound Changes Masters} The Hound Changes Masters. The coterie makes a pact with Halloway. Whitmore falls. David becomes Sheriff or the Hound of the new regime. Stains and a risk to Humanity for whoever makes the pact. Montgomery becomes an enemy.
@UUID[JournalEntry.oyw1B5aZ7G2vFDuO.JournalEntryPage.xgVY2zlstK7IN1Rp]{FIN-C · Cleansing Fire} Purifying Fire. The File is destroyed along with all its copies. The Masquerade is saved. Helen's life's work disappears. Her relationship with David, for whom she is a Touchstone, is damaged.
@UUID[JournalEntry.oyw1B5aZ7G2vFDuO.JournalEntryPage.on9MlxGjJpFF8yf2]{FIN-D · Red Tide} Red Tide. The File reaches FIRSTLIGHT. Purge. Loss of Haven or Resources. The chronicle continues as a survival campaign (H5 variant).

pages.name: Epilogue—“What the Water Doesn't Carry Away”

text.content: There are three codas depending on the ending: Emily's grave (@UUID[JournalEntry.uhtM1iF2WrHHlcd8]{Emily Smith's Grave}), Helen's podcast, or the silence of the hangar. They plant @UUID[JournalEntry.AnZpyM4onyACPwiC.JournalEntryPage.Y1E4i0kdsA7wcPIj]{GAN-10 · Letters from Cluj} (the letter from “M.V.”) as a seed for the chronicle.

Editor's Note · Clue Names

The names of P-07 through P-11 are the ones from the newest installments (docs 11 to 13). In the outline (doc 01) they were: P-07 “Halloway Knows Too Much About Vance,” P-08 “Krell's Inverted Guard,” P-09 “The Journals Sold in 1986,” P-10 “Shipments to ‘SEA-0411,’” P-11 “Preston Gale's Digital Signature.” Installments 2 and 3 add P-13 (Sal's ledger), P-14 (the payment from Cascade Holdings), and P-15 (the German's folios).
